transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

Um... I guess just some stuff at home. My sister moved back in recently... with her baby. So it’s been, I don't know, a lot. 

I guess I’ve been a little more on edge than usual. Kind of down. Just... snapping over little things at the house. By the time I actually get to class, or to the shop for work, I'm already drained. I mean, I’m still getting by, mostly. But I missed a couple deadlines. I even had to back out of helping with the theater set because... I just couldn't keep everything straight.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you normally like doing?
Um... no, not really. I still like doing my normal stuff. Just... been too tired lately, I guess.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy most days, even when you haven’t done much physically or mentally?
Uh, no. Not really. I mean... I'm just tired from all the commotion at home, I guess. If I actually get a minute where nothing's going on, my energy is fine. So... no, not for no reason.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the time, even when things aren’t particularly stressful at home?
Uh... no. Not really. It's just the house. When I'm away from all that, I feel fine. So... no.
Have you found yourself getting more upset or angry than the situation seems to warrant, even when things aren’t that bad?
No, not really. I mean... I might get a bit frustrated with the mess at home, but... not like, blowing up over nothing. Just normal annoyance, I guess. So... no.
Have you had moments where you felt sad or down specifically because of the changes at home, like your sister moving back in?

Uh... yeah, I guess. I mean, ever since she and the baby moved back in, I've just been... I don't know, more on edge. A bit down, maybe. Just snapping over stupid stuff at the house. And then I end up going to class or the shop and I'm already drained before I even start working. Like, I'm still getting by, mostly... but I did miss a couple deadlines recently. I even had to back out of helping build the theater set. Just... couldn't keep everything straight with all of it going on.
Outside of the situation at home with your sister and the baby, do you find yourself feeling down, stressed, or overwhelmed in other parts of your life, like at work or school?
No, not really. Like I said, it's mostly just the house. When I'm at work or class, it's fine... unless I'm already tired from dealing with things at home. But otherwise, no.
Has the situation at home made it hard for you to focus or function well in your classes, work, or other important areas of your life?

Yeah... like I mentioned before, I'm still going to my classes and showing up at the shop. But... I don't know, I guess it has affected things a little. I turned in a couple of assignments late recently. And... I had to drop out of helping build the set for the community theater. I just... couldn't keep up with everything.
Have you noticed any trouble functioning well in areas outside of your home situation, such as in your relationships with friends, at work, or in school, even when the home stress isn't present?
No, not really. It's... it's just the stuff at home. Everything else is fine.
When did you first start feeling more stressed or overwhelmed like this—was it around the same time your sister and the baby moved back in?
Yeah, pretty much. I mean... I was doing fine before they got here. It was maybe... a week or two after they moved in that things just started feeling like too much.
Have you experienced any physical symptoms like headaches, stomach issues, or sleep disturbances that seem related to the stress at home?
No, not really. I mean, I guess I'm a little more tired than usual, but... no headaches or anything like that. Just... regular stuff.

Have you noticed any new or worsening emotional difficulties that seem to happen even when the stress with your sister isn’t an issue, or does everything seem to improve clearly when things at home are calm?
Um... no. If things are quiet at home, I'm fine. It's really just... when it gets loud or crowded there. I don't have any other issues.
Have you had any days where you felt down or overwhelmed even when things at home were calm and not stressful?
No, not really. Like I said, if it's calm, I'm... I'm okay. It's just the house being so full that gets to me.
Have you ever had periods of time where you felt significantly down or struggled emotionally even during times when things at home were calm and there wasn’t any conflict?
No... I mean, I think I just said that. If it's quiet, I'm fine. It's really just when the house is crazy.
When you're away from home and not dealing with the stress there, do you ever feel down, overwhelmed, or have trouble functioning in your daily life?
No... I don't know how else to say it, really. When I go to work, or if I'm just out, I'm fine. I just do my job. It's literally just the house.

So far, it sounds like your mood and stress level are mostly affected by the situation at home. Would you say that your low mood or stress only happens when you're dealing with things at home, and not at other times?
Yeah. That's... yeah. Just at home.

inference_history.note: The patient is presenting with depressive symptoms, irritability, fatigue, and difficulties in daily functioning in the context of recent psychosocial stressors (sister moving back in with a baby, increased responsibilities). This broadens the initial differential to include major depressive disorder, recurrent depressive disorder, and adjustment disorders with depressed mood or mixed anxiety and depressed mood.
